definitions.explanation: To produce speech, to communicate verbally. Used for speaking a language, talking to someone, or giving a speech.
To convey information or a story to someone. {話|はなし}を{話|はな}す sounds redundant, so often {話|はなし}をする is used instead.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}を{話|はな}せますか。
{友達|ともだち}と{話|はな}しました。
{本当|ほんとう}のことを{話|はな}してください。

notes: {話|はな}す is the basic verb for speaking. Compare with {言|い}う (to say) which focuses on the content of what is said, while {話|はな}す focuses on the act of speaking or having a conversation. Te-form: {話|はな}して.
